query: What recurring issues drive resolution inefficiency?

per_column.name: resolution_days
per_column.rationale: Resolution duration is an outcome/measure of (in)efficiency, not a constitutive aspect of the reasons driving it. It is a symptom, not a facet of the reason concept.

per_column.name: issue_type
per_column.rationale: The nature/category of the underlying issue is a genuine aspect OF why incidents are inefficient to resolve (e.g., hardware vs software vs network drivers of difficulty).

per_column.name: assignee_avg_resolution_days
per_column.rationale: A performance metric of the assignee that may correlate with inefficiency but is an external driver/measure, not a constitutive part of the inefficiency-reason concept.

per_column.name: is_high_priority
per_column.rationale: Priority is a contextual attribute of the incident, not an aspect OF the reasons for inefficiency; it is a potential moderator/predictor.

per_column.name: issue_type_frequency
per_column.rationale: This is a derived aggregate count of issue_type, redundant with issue_type and adding no distinct facet; it overlaps entirely with an existing column.

per_column.name: inefficiency_pattern
per_column.rationale: A composite label combining priority/category/delay flags; it restates the whole inefficiency concept as a bundled tag rather than isolating one non-overlapping facet, and duplicates is_high_priority and delay signals.

judge.rationale: The concept 'incident_inefficiency_reasons' calls for constitutive causal facets of why resolution is inefficient (e.g., process/handoff delays, categorization/routing errors, skill/staffing gaps, information/diagnostic gaps, tooling issues). Only issue_type qualifies as a genuine aspect OF the reasons. The remaining columns are outcome measures (resolution_days, assignee_avg_resolution_days), contextual predictors (is_high_priority), a redundant aggregate of issue_type (issue_type_frequency), or a bundled restatement of the whole concept (inefficiency_pattern). Mutual exclusivity is low because issue_type, issue_type_frequency, and inefficiency_pattern overlap, and duration measures repeat. Exhaustiveness is very low: with only one true facet, the main constitutive dimensions of inefficiency reasons are largely uncovered.
